Create/replacement omission or null means no preference; patch omission preserves, null clears. Zero permits purchase. Prominent advice: strictly over 20% above a positive preference, or any positive actual above zero. Unknown actuals stay unknown.

excludeProductIds.description: Exclude only these products. Does not remove requested nutrients. [] clears this exclusion.

excludeSupplementIds.description: Exclude products containing these nutrient concepts, not particular product IDs. [] clears this exclusion.

anyOf.description: Preferred daily pill count; unknown counts remain unknown.

maxProductCount.description: Preferred distinct new products; there is no system minimum or maximum basket count.

productDoses.description: Fix returned products at these daily labelled servings; other products remain optimisable. Use administration metadata for measurable quantities. [] clears proposals. servingsPerDay.description: Positive quantity in this field’s stated units. Nutrient quantities also use the documented dose precision.

basis.description: total_daily covers known dietary intake, continued supplements and new products; supplemental covers continued supplements and new products only. Web food-gap recommendations explicitly use supplemental. Estimated intake affects dose-fit ranges, never guaranteed coverage.

requestPatch.description: Merge supplied object fields; supplied arrays replace completely; [] clears arrays; null clears only the advisory preferences requirements.maxProductCount, maxDailyPills and maxPriceMinor; null elsewhere is invalid. {} explicitly refreshes contract/policy without changing inputs.

matchingDiagnostics.description: Snapshot candidate counts and work actually evaluated; not a proof that every global combination was searched. Listing and unique-product counts are separate. Numeric preferences and health advice never reject candidates.

anyOf.description: Optional pointer to an existing selectable, nonempty, distinct positive-coverage option. Present the closest result and this alternative with their existing gaps, goods price and pill information. Null when none qualifies or continued intake already covers every target.

adviceIds.description: Inline advice for the selected and highlighted options. Empty on background options does not mean no findings: select an option or request its advice details. Missing-reference notices may summarize several original findings.

findings.description: Distinct findings in a grouped conversation notice. Each measurement keeps its own identity, reference and unit; the message states every finding. Full/details retain original messages, contributors and provenance.

planAdviceIds.description: Plan-wide findings, resolved in this response’s advice array even when there is no product option.

s84.description: Verified nonnegative contributions when actual is unknown. This is a lower bound, not an exact total; exact delta and percentage stay null.

s0.description: Advisory numeric preference comparison. actual/preferred/delta use unit; percent is signed deviation from a positive preference and null for zero, absent preference or unknown actual. More than 20% above a positive preference, or any positive amount above zero, is prominent; selection and purchase remain available.

s3.description: Dimensionless normalized dose deviation: 1 equals 100%. total=under+over+2*limit, using symmetric deviations from requested targets, normalized newly added dose above an explicitly known continued-dose reference for unrequested nutrients, and additional applicable upper-limit excess. Unknown or estimated continued doses never create a reference denominator. This is a dose-fit ranking measure, not a clinical risk or approval score.

s78.description: Condition codes from info.conditionCodes; unrecognised reported context is preserved as unassessed advice.

s79.description: Medication codes from info.medicationCodes; omission means unknown, not confirmed none.

s87.description: Daily amount in the accompanying unit; zero must be explicitly reported.

s67.description: Positive remaining days of retained inventory. Omit when unknown. If none remains, remove this retained inventory entry and revise the intended request.

s76.description: Quantified continued supplements. Omission means unknown; [] explicitly reports none. A (productId, nutrient) pair may occur only once across this field and current-source intake observations.

s66.description: Current-supplement observations only: positive remaining days of retained stock. Omit unknown duration. Invalid for diet observations.

s63.description: Reported daily intake. Missing quantities are unknown, never zero. Broad dietary descriptions are accepted without labels or portion sizes.

s68.description: Reported observations. Omission or [] does not establish zero dietary intake. An explicitly reported known amount of 0 is required to establish zero for a nutrient.

s81.description: Supported comparison horizons in days. The response exposes the 30- and 90-day ledgers; other periods are unavailable.

s64.description: Actual catalogue servings per day for this comparison basket. Omission makes equivalent-coverage savings unavailable; quantity remains packs purchased.

s65.description: Positive quantity in this field’s stated units. Nutrient quantities also use the documented dose precision.
